scope:
Independent rotated linear gradients, Calc normalization and PDF vectors.

Source flags/angles, producer properties and effective native paint vectors are
separate facts. They do not establish Excel/WPS behavior or SDK policy.
limits: Calc rewrites rotating gradients as fixed fields with adjusted angles, drops scaled and can change flip appearance on reopen. Source flags/angles remain independent.
Native quarter-turn geometry can change extents; transform extents and anchor markers remain recorded separately.
Normalized native band vectors are rounded to three decimals and do not claim whole-page pixels or Excel/WPS machine verification.
